# The profile condition fix moves platform selection into configure dependency expressions

The landing replaces a Python if/else over target dependency objects with two imply_option when expressions. It selects Thunderbird for Windows or macOS and thunderbird when both platform conditions are false. The commit attributes the previous always-true branch to checking a non-None dependency object. Current source retains that platform spelling split and separately conditions enterprise names. Keep this exact configure-expression and profile-compatibility scope; the paired Gecko dependency implementation and runtime profile generation were not inspected or executed.

Scope: Thunderbird application identity configuration.
